## Requirements (contract)

1. **Shared versioned URL state** (`release`, compartment `collection`, query
   `q`, repeated facets, `focus`, `view`, `page`) honoured by the map, search
   and network islands AND the equivalent static routes — `sig.workspace-state/1`.
2. **Complete, bounded static navigation** — paginated tables that provably
   end (no unbounded fallback tables), concise named-denominator landings,
   a focused record/evidence pane, bounded network expansion.
3. **Preserve the no-basemap, tile-only map** and the existing island
   allowances; measured per-island JS/network budgets without broadly
   relaxing static limits.

### Out of scope (must NOT do)

- No deploy/publish/live exposure (GATE-G3; `live_verification=false`).
- No general SPA / client router, no basemap, no licence-mixed surfaces, no
  accounts/uploads/collaboration/AI chat, no source rights flips, no human
  labels, no spine writes, no rewriting landed ADR bodies or prior run
  evidence.

## Design (ADR-134)

- **`sig.workspace-state/1`** (`web/src/lib/workspace-state.ts`, ~300 lines,
  pure): canonical emitted order `v`, `release`, repeated `collection`, `q`,
  repeated `kind`/`jurisdiction`/`technology`/`source`, `location` (P32.14
  vocabulary), `focus`, `view` (`list|map|network` ↔ `/search/`, `/map/`,
  `/network/`), `page`. `v`+`view` always emitted; defaults omitted.
  Tolerant-with-receipts parse — unsupported `v`/unknown `view`/`location`/
  unusable `page` fall back AND report `issues` the islands render visibly;
  unknown extras ignored.
- **`collectionSpecified`** — a bare `collection=` param is the explicitly-
  empty "0 of N compartments" selection, distinct from absent = all; the
  map toggle canonicalises a full selection back to the absent default.
- **`focus` = self-describing `sig.published-record/1` record_key** where one
  resolves (`recordRoutes` derives page/JSON/compartment hrefs), else the
  honest "not in this view" pane + released-record link; island node/asset
  ids where the fixtures use them.
- **`clearFocusOutOfScope`** — a selection leaving scope is dropped AND
  announced (`role="status"`); `page` resets on every query/filter change.
- **`useWorkspaceState`** (`web/src/islands/workspace.ts`) — the only DOM/
  history adapter: mount parse (deep links/reloads), `push`/`replace`,
  `popstate` restore. No router, no global store.
- **Bounded ego** (`boundedEgoNetwork`): 50 nodes / 100 edges caps, true
  totals stated, deterministic truncation, one-ring expansion by selection.
- **Bounded map indicators** (`boundedJurisdictionIndicators`, ≤50 inline
  ids/jurisdiction, true count kept); the no-JS located table paginates
  (100 rows/page) instead of dumping.
- **`NetworkEdge.evidence?: string[]`** — backing claim ids, emitted on both
  materialized and shaped export paths; the three §12.2 access kinds stay
  distinct and citable end-to-end.
- **Measured budgets**: `measure-island-budgets.mjs` →
  `docs/build/reports/p32.15-island-budgets.md`; ceilings in
  `web/tests/e2e/island-budgets.json`, wire-asserted by `budget.spec.ts`,
  mirrored in `lighthouserc.json` per-island assertMatrix blocks.

## Acceptance criteria → test matrix

| # | AC | Test |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | deep link/back/forward/reload restores record + release across views; unlocated navigable | `workspace.spec.ts` (deep-linked network focus + Back/Forward; search q+focus restore; release pinning across views; bare-id map focus; record-key focus "not in this view" pane + released-record link; network focus miss); `workspace.nojs.spec.ts` (static switch carries v/view/release on all three pages; indicator rows link records) |
| 2 | focus kept only in scope; cleared selection announced | `workspace.spec.ts` "a query that removes the focused record clears it — announced, not silent"; `clearFocusOutOfScope` unit tests |
| 3 | unknown/malformed state fails visibly | `workspace.spec.ts` "unknown state values fail visibly"; unit parse tests (v=9, view=galaxy, location=inside, page=0/-2/x/1.5) |
| 4 | deterministic serialization, repeated facets, explicit empty | `workspace-state.test.ts` (omits-defaults canonical string; repeated facets keep multiplicity/order; `collection=` round-trips as specified-empty) |
| 5 | bounded graph expansion, stated totals | `network.test.ts` boundedEgoNetwork caps/order/truncated flag; `workspace.spec.ts` bounds note; island keyboard re-centre |
| 6 | edge detail distinguishes access kinds, names claims | `test_network_reads_materialized_edges_else_falls_back` (evidence == ["c9"]); fixture edge `evidence` fields; `workspace.nojs.spec.ts` "edge supporting claims visible without JS"; island `edge-evidence` lists |
| 7 | compartment switch updates data + attribution | `workspace.spec.ts` "compartment switching updates the URL state and the attribution line" (All 1 → 0 of 1 → back/forward) |
| 8 | static zero-script/150-KiB + island budgets | `budget.spec.ts` wire-measured vs `island-budgets.json`; `lighthouserc.json` per-island assertMatrix; `islands.nojs.spec.ts` + `content.nojs.spec.ts` inert-fallback suites unchanged and green; a11y suite (WCAG 2.2 AA) green incl. `/map/` `/network/` `/search/` |
| 9 | map viewport never in URL | `workspace.spec.ts` "the viewport is never written to the URL" |

### Self-review findings → fixed in-run

- **Explicit-empty compartment selection unrepresentable** — the first
  compartment-toggle e2e failed: unchecking the only compartment wrote
  `collection=[]` which canonicalised to absent (= all), so the checkbox
  reverted. Fixed by `collectionSpecified`: a bare `collection=` param is
  the linkable "none" state; absent stays "all". Unit tests pin the
  round-trip.
- **Keyboard test targeted a 2-hop node** — "Tulsa PD" is not in the
  okcpd ego's first ring by design (bounded ego); the test now exercises
  the real ring-1 node (`rtcc:okc`).
- **Budget script missed the MapLibre worker** — the worker URL is an
  inlined `/_astro/` string, not a relative import; the walk now follows
  both forms, so map script-family honestly counts 1.79 MB incl. the
  507 KB worker, and the map ceiling was set against that measurement.
- **Generated mirrors** — `BACKLOG.md` + `docs/adr/README.md` regenerated
  after the ADR-134/BL-058 edits (checker-flagged, then green).
